## Summary

Describe the problem, the proposed solution, and the resulting user-visible behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --locked --all-targets`
- [ ] `cargo build --locked --release`
- [ ] Regression tests were added or updated where practical.
- [ ] User-facing documentation and the changelog were updated where necessary.
- [ ] The change includes no credentials, session material, private identifiers, state databases, logs, or build output.

## Compatibility and data impact

Describe any effect on Telegram requests, account or source access, proxies, cooldowns, scheduling, checkpoints, partial files, filenames, state migrations, backward compatibility, or security. Write `None` when there is no effect.
